cause: Repeated access through python-docx paragraph proxy list in a hot loop caused the user-visible Python step to exceed its execution window.
failed_approach: Build + full validation + artifact writes in one user-visible Python execution.
recovery: Continued from generated artifacts; used container-side linear verification; canonical render; pixel-by-pixel regression; audit finalized only after verification.
boundary: Tool/runtime efficiency issue only; no source or output semantic data loss.
prevention: Use cached paragraph text/index arrays and split build/validate/render phases for very large DOCX jobs.
